blocks.text: A bottle cap found drifting off Japan’s western coast carried a tiny ecosystem of 307 creatures from waters near the Philippines, a study by Japanese researchers has found. The cap, collected in waters off Kochi Prefecture in January 2023, likely traveled on the Kuroshio Current, a north-flowing, warm ocean current in the western North Pacific, for at least 70 days, according to the group led by Nagoya University. The finding by the team of researchers from Kyoto University and institutions such as the Japan Agency for Marine-Earth Science and Technology also shows how even small pieces of marine litter can transport […]...
